subject: Renewal: Reserved pool increase + model mix change — Skyline Payments
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@skylinepayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal proposal — reserved pool increase + optional reranker add-on

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our QBR we prepared an updated renewal that aligns with Skyline's expected growth and the model changes you mentioned. Key summary: 

- Term: 12 months (renewal starts 2027-01-01)
- Reserved capacity: increase from 8 to 14 GPUs (dedicated A10G baseline), with an option to upgrade 4 of those slots to H100s for high-throughput reranker jobs
- Throughput guardrail: 99.5% of requests under 180ms p99 for standard generation workloads on the A10G pool; H100s targeted to keep reranker batch latencies <120ms p95 for 8k context reranks
- Model mix change: moving 30% of traffic to a new 13B long-context variant (13B-16k) and enabling a lightweight reranker pipeline (separate reserved queue)
- Price delta: +26% over current committed spend (details in attached model_mix_costing.xlsx).

Attachments: proposal PDF and cost workbook.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the proposal and confirm whether Skyline wants the H100 upgrade for the 4 slots (this affects pricing and the final SLA).
2) If yes, we'll prepare a term amendment and DocuSign packet; if no, we proceed with 14 A10G-only GPUs and slightly relaxed reranker throughput SLOs.
3) Marissa can follow up with a technical runbook for the reranker rollout.

Happy to hop on a 30m call tomorrow to walk through.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment stubs: Skyline_Renewal_Redwood_Proposal_Q4-2026.pdf (PDF, 5 pages), model_mix_costing.xlsx (Excel)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@skylinepayments.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Farooq <aisha.farooq@skylinepayments.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — reserved pool increase + optional reranker add-on

Monica —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few quick clarifying Qs from our side before we escalate internally:

- The 13B-16k model: what's the expected per-token cost delta vs your current 7B baseline in the workbook? We want to confirm whether the 30% traffic shift causes a big budget spike.
- For the reranker: we need a strong p95 SLA for peak-day checkout flows (Black Friday-like bursts). Is the separate reserved queue billed the same as regular reserved GPUs or is there a premium?
- If we opt for H100s for 4 nodes, what's the lead time to provision and any expected migration windows?

We're evaluating two scenarios: (A) go all-A10G and accept slightly higher reranker latency, or (B) take H100s for the reranker to keep conversion-critical flows fast. We'll need a recommended configuration to present to finance.

CCing Aisha (head of engineering) — Aisha, can you confirm whether the 16k context model and reranker will require changes to our internal batching logic? If so, we may ask for a short pilot window.

Thanks —
Liam
Director of Product, Skyline Payments
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@skylinepayments.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — reserved pool increase + optional reranker add-on

Hi Liam / Monica,

Quick technical reply to the questions above — I pulled numbers from the costing workbook and added operational notes. TL;DR: recommend a hybrid pool (10 A10G + 4 H100) for Skyline's risk profile.

Cost and perf notes:
- Per-token: 13B-16k ~1.9x cost vs current 7B baseline in typical generation mode (this is model compute; tokenization/IO adds ~5%). See "model_mix_costing.xlsx" tab "per_token_estimates".
- Reranker: the reranker pipeline we recommend runs a smaller cross-encoder (3-4B) for candidate scoring but with higher batch sizes. If the reranker is run on A10G only, expect p95 latencies in the 140–220ms range under peak bursts; H100s bring that down to ~80–120ms p95 for 8k sequences at 32-batch.
- Batching/queueing: we'll route reranker requests to a dedicated queue with prefix/KV-cache disabled for scoring jobs to stabilize latency. That queue consumes reserved GPU slots and is billed as reserved capacity (no hidden premium) but the H100 reservation is priced higher in the proposal.
- Provisioning: H100 nodes: typical lead time 7–10 business days to stand up and test; migration requires a 1–2 hour config window for canary traffic shift (we can do night/weekend).

Pilot suggestion:
- 2-week pilot with 2 H100s + 4 A10G as a "pilot burst" to validate reranker p95 and conversion delta. If pilot metrics look good, scale to full 4 H100s and the remaining A10G slots. Pilot billed at prorated reserved rate.

Operational asks for Skyline engineering:
- Ensure your client SDK can signal reranker requests via the x-redd-pref header (we'll provide snippet).
- Share your expected peak RPS profile for Black Friday style bursts so we can size batch windows appropriately.

If you want I can produce a short benchmark report (3 days) running your representative payload — we'll need a small anonymized prompt set.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Thanks Marissa — helpful detail.

A couple follow-ups after an internal huddle:
- We're comfortable with a 2-week pilot for the reranker. Please send the benchmark request template and any data handling agreement we need to sign.
- Finance wants to evaluate a modest one-time credit if we sign up for the H100 option — they'd like to see a 6–8% onboarding credit on the first billing period.
- Engineering will provide peak-day RPS by EOD Monday.

I'll confirm with Aisha whether the SDK change is trivial — sounds likely.

— Liam
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Approval request: one-time onboarding credit for Skyline H100 option

Rafael / Priyom —

Quick ask: Skyline are leaning toward option B (adding 4 H100 slots for the reranker) but finance is requesting a 6–8% one-time onboarding credit on the first invoice to offset their expected pilot tuning costs. Deal details: 12-month renewal, committed monthly spend will be ~+26% vs prior year, reserved pool 14 GPUs (10 A10G + 4 H100), pilot period 2 weeks (prorated).

Why I recommend approving:
- Upsell moves Skyline to a materially larger committed base; retaining them at scale has ~3x NRR/expansion chance vs starting a new small deal.
- Approving a modest onboarding credit accelerates signature and reduces the chance they go to a competitor for the H100 burst window.

Suggested approvers / accounting flow: apply credit as a one-time invoice line item. I can attach language to the DocuSign if you approve.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
